Hi Guys, I have a question regarding content for this verse.

On that other site, there was a section for news but it was actually solely for US news.

There was then another section called worldnews for everything else.

Just wondering if the same situation applies here?

My view(as someone who isn't US based) is that v/news is going to be the most frequently visited news verse and as a result it should focus on world news, perhaps with a separate verse for US news..

It always seemed counterintuitive that 'news' should only focus on one country..

Edit: paragraphs
Currently news about some US beverage on the page. Mods please direct US internal news to their respective subverse.

It always seemed counterintuitive that 'news' should only focus on one country..

Does it not also seem counterintuitive that "news" should exclude one country specifically? Compounding the fact that a great deal of the site's users are US-based?

I honestly never understood the reasoning behind removal of the US from worldnews outside of a need to be elitist. If we're going to use a different sub just for US-based news, regardless of the fact that we have a relatively small userbase, then why stop there? Why not create a sub for every country's news and then make /v/news a place to find links to other country's news? Likely because it's an easy to find location... and it's a default.

My vote is that we leave /v/news open, and if someone wants to make a niche sub to specify a country's news articles that they do so of their own accord and not because their links being forced out of /v/news simply because they're from a specific country.

US news shouldn't be excluded specifically. It's really a question of whether domestic news should be included from any country. At the moment /v/news is basically a cross between /v/WorldNews and /v/USNews

as it's just called 'news' I think it's reasonable to expect that it would have a broader focus.
